table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode,
	Type = CASE WHEN P.PurCatCode=3 THEN 'OPEN' WHEN P.PurCatCode = 2 THEN 'PACK' ELSE 'LOOSE' END,
	Date = P.Date,
	Supplier = A.Name,
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = (D.LooseQty + D.PackQty),
	BonusQty = D.BonusQty,
	NetRate = D.NetRate,
	SalePrice = D.SalePriceForItem,
	Margin =ROUND( ((D.SalePriceForItem - D.NetRate) / CASE WHEN D.SalePriceForItem=0 THEN 1 ELSE D.SalePriceForItem END)* 100, 2),
	PreviousInvCode=(SELECT MAX(PP.PurInvCode)
			FROM PurLedger PP, PurDetail DD
			WHERE
				PP.Posted = 'Y' AND 
				DD.ICode = D.ICode AND
				PP.PurInvCode=DD.PurInvCode),
	PreviousMargin=(SELECT Margin = MAX(ROUND(((DD.SalePriceForItem - DD.NetRate) / CASE WHEN DD.SalePriceForItem = 0 THEN 1 ELSE DD.SalePriceForItem END) * 100, 2))
			FROM PurLedger PP, PurDetail DD
			WHERE
				PP.Posted = 'Y' AND 
				DD.ICode = D.ICode AND
				PP.PurInvCode=DD.PurInvCode),
	ID=D.PurrowID
FROM
	PurLedger P,
	PurDetail D,
	Item I,
	Accounts A
WHERE 
	P.PurInvCode BETWEEN :al_start AND :al_end AND
	P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
	P.Posted = 'N' AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	P.SuppCode = A.AccCode
